name: Mall Shopfront Roller Shutter
summary: Metal shopfront shutter with 28 independently editable slats, U-section side guides, removable hood sheets, roller and bottom rail.
description: Original generic 3 m shutter curtain for Singapore/Malaysia mall scenes, distinct from the glass door module. One logical asset, V2.1 P0 item 425, batch item 6/10.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and Principled materials; no third-party models, artwork, textures or fonts.

assembly.instructions: Place ASSET_MallShopfrontRollerShutter at floor level. FRAME_Fixed retains guides and hood sheets; CURTAIN_EditableSlats contains 28 separate slats plus bottom rail and seal; ROLLER_Assembly contains drum and axle stubs. The Blender generate.py pose(lift) helper sets a geometric inward-spiral winding path for lift 0 to 2.6 m. Imported objects explicitly use XYZ rotation mode. Closed, 1.3 m part-open and 2.6 m open previews use actual exported meshes. mechanism-cutaway intentionally hides only hood sheets and is labelled as a cutaway.

material_notes: 44 independent closed meshes and four editable material groups: galvanized slats, charcoal housing, steel hardware and rubber seal. No textures or external artwork. The roller is a static circular core; geometric poses move the curtain and bottom rail, not a simulated motor.
accuracy_notes: Generic visual concept, not a mechanical, motor, physical safety, security, fire, structural or installation specification. Static gallery viewing only, no runtime click interaction or exported animation clips. Geometric slat winding is a visual editing aid, not an engineering chain/linkage simulation.

attribution.credit: Original geometry and materials authored for Blender-3D-Gallery; no external artwork.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

quality_gate.scope: Local artifact and visual approval PASS; actual exported closed, part-open, open and cutaway studio views plus gallery pixels inspected. Overall NEEDS REVIEW because physical Android/iOS remain untested. No runtime shutter or motor interaction is claimed.
